subject.title: [Feature]: Support sessionKey-based concurrency guard for webhook       deliveries

question: Should hook-agent deliveries with the same resolved sessionKey be rejected, skipped, queued, or remain parallel/accepted by default, and should any 409-style behavior be opt-in?
rationale: The requested behavior changes a public webhook response contract and retry semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the default compatibility policy or how it should interact with open persistent-session and queue work.

options.title: Add Opt-In Overlap Policy
options.body: Keep current accepted-by-default behavior while adding a trusted mapping/direct-hook policy such as reject, skip, queue, or parallel with documented retry semantics.

options.title: Make 409 Default
options.body: Reject same-session active or queued hook deliveries by default, accepting that existing integrations may need migration to avoid retry storms.

options.title: Keep Caller-Managed Locking
options.body: Document idempotency keys and client-side locks as the supported concurrency control and leave OpenClaw accepting repeated hook deliveries.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Overlap Policy
recommendation.body: Keep current accepted-by-default behavior while adding a trusted mapping/direct-hook policy such as reject, skip, queue, or parallel with documented retry semantics.
